howToUse: This is your 'My Brain Doesn't Write' Reframe Script Bank — seventeen pre-written self-coaching prompts you read aloud (or silently) the moment a specific stuck feeling surfaces while you're writing. Each script is one to three sentences, written in the plain spoken voice you already use on a discovery call. Open it in a separate tab whenever you sit down to write, and go straight to the stuck moment that matches where you are right now.
promise: Use these scripts to redirect the fear that your brain isn't wired to write — and keep moving inside a session instead of closing the document. Every script maps to the exact moment it's designed to dissolve, so you're never searching for the right reframe when you need it most.

tools.name: The Blank Page Scripts (Stuck Moments 1–6)
tools.instructions: Read the script that matches your stuck moment out loud before typing a single word — do not edit it, do not improve it, just say it and open a new line.
tools.content:
## The Blank Page Scripts — Stuck Moments 1–6

Use these the moment you open a new document and feel the familiar freeze. Find the sentence that most accurately names what you're experiencing right now, read it once, and begin.

nextStep.heading: Your Next Move Inside the Programme
nextStep.body: Take the script bank into your very next writing session — open it alongside your draft before you write a single word. Then bring whatever you wrote, however rough, to your next programme session. The Client Psychology Reverse-Map works best when your coach can see a real attempt on the page, not a blank one — so a rough draft with your own voice showing through is exactly the right material to bring.
